entries.heading: PROCUREMENT OF TELECOMMUNICATIONS SUPPLIES FOR EXPERIMENTAL PURPOSES
ancestors: TITLE VIII—ACQUISITION POLICY, ACQUISITION MANAGEMENT, AND RELATED MATTERS
entries.text:
SEC. 886. PROCUREMENT OF TELECOMMUNICATIONS SUPPLIES FOR 
                        EXPERIMENTAL PURPOSES.

    Section 2373(a) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by 
inserting ``telecommunications,'' after ``space-flight,''.
